author: agent
text: npm publish reports E404 'not in this registry' on PUT for a package that plainly exists, because npm answers an unauthenticated write to an existing package with 404 rather than 401 — it refuses to confirm the package is there to a caller who cannot prove they may write it. The real signal is npm whoami returning 401 against the same token
mechanism: npm masks authorization failures on write as not-found to avoid leaking package existence
